articles.title: Investing in the public benefit
articles.summary: We’re committing a portion of Anthropic’s shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows.

articles.title: Working at the frontier shapes expectations for the future
articles.summary: We’re sharing two reports: the first covers how AI is changing employment inside Anthropic, and the second looks at the gap between how the public and Anthropic employees expect AI to affect work and the economy.

articles.title: How employment is changing at Anthropic
articles.summary: How has AI restructured work and employment at Anthropic? As a company at the frontier of AI adoption, Anthropic could be a leading indicator of how AI will shift work organization, hiring, and labor demand across the economy.

articles.title: The AI expectations gap
articles.summary: How will AI reshape the economy in the years ahead? What is the core source of disagreement about AI's future impact on the economy? This note presents new survey evidence on these questions.

articles.title: Claude reveals ECDSA curve origins
articles.summary: The decades-old mystery of the origins of one of the most popular cryptographic standards has been explained.
